# North Pole Polygon

A diamond-shaped polygon encircling the north pole in EPSG:4326. The ring has vertices at latitudes 84N to 89.5N spanning longitudes -90 to 90. This exercises projection code that must handle polar regions correctly -- simple equirectangular math collapses near the poles and area/perimeter calculations become highly sensitive to the projection chosen.

## What this case checks

Ensure polygon-based utilities handle geometries near the north pole without crashing or producing wildly incorrect area calculations.

## Risk types covered

- [`area_distortion`](../risk/area-distortion.md)
- [`polar_projection_singularity`](../risk/polar-projection-singularity.md)
